Prices and rates

All prices are quoted in GEL, VAT included. Conversions use a rate of 1 USD = 2.70 ₾. The rates are valid throughout 2026; a seasonal adjustment applies in July and August (+15%).

What the price includes

  • CDW insurance coverage — damage cover for the vehicle above the excess.
  • Third-party liability insurance (TPL) — the compulsory cover.
  • Unlimited mileage within Georgia.
  • Servicing and wear items — oil, filters, tyres.
  • 24/7 roadside assistance nationwide.
  • Winter tyres from 1 December to 1 April.
  • 18% VAT — the prices quoted are final.

Deposit

The deposit is blocked on a credit or debit card when the rental starts and is released within 3 business days of the car being returned, provided there is no damage or fine. When paying in cash, the deposit is taken in cash and returned on the spot.

Corporate rates

Contracts longer than 3 months and covering 3 or more vehicles are priced individually. Corporate clients receive:

  • A discount of 25–40% off the base rate, depending on volume
  • A single monthly invoice and tax invoice
  • A replacement vehicle in the event of a breakdown — within 6 hours
  • The right to brand our vans at no extra charge
  • A monthly cost report broken down by vehicle

Payment methods

  • Cash (GEL, US dollars, euros)
  • Visa, Mastercard, American Express
  • Bank transfer (for companies)
  • Online payment through the website is not available — this site is informational
